name: (11) Dominate — 3 Advanced — Still the Mortal Flesh

system.description:
Your will overrides not only the mind but the body, cutting off a victim's senses or stilling the very beat of their heart.

Spend a Willpower Trait and make a normal Mental Challenge against the subject (retest Intimidation); the power works on vampires and mortals alike. On a success you shut off or make erratic one involuntary function - hearing, sight, circulation, perspiration, reflex movement and the like. A mortal whose heart is stopped dies immediately (though prompt medical care within minutes may revive them). Cutting off a vampire's circulation or respiration is useless, but rendering one deaf or blind is quite effective.
